designationHistory.indexText: Established on August 16, 1971, to protect habitat for the dusky seaside sparrow and other threatened and endangered species.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: St. Johns National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Dec. 14, 2009 (E9-29637), St. Johns NWR CCP: "The refuge was established in 1971 to provide protection for threatened and endangered species"

review.note: Year confirmed independently; the day (Aug. 16) rests on FWS. Not a presidential action; Nixon is only the administration in office.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Johns NWR was established on August 16, 1971, to provide habitat for threatened and endangered species, specifically for the conservation of the dusky seaside sparrow ( Ammodramus maritimus nigrescens ).
